name: KAIKAN ~Yorokobi~
source:
Main character buys some magical medicine in the adult toy shop. It is a medicine that allows to travel to a lewd world. After drinking he finds himself in front of a Western-style mansion. The house steward requests him to train three lewd demon girls: sister type, loli type and innocent sister type.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在成人玩具店购买了一些神奇的药物。这是一种可以前往淫乱世界的药物。喝完酒后，他发现自己站在一座西式豪宅前。管家要求他训练三个淫荡魔女：姐姐型、萝莉型、清纯妹妹型。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
